title: Lessons from Anti-waste Social Experiment that Seemed to Generate More Waste
what_it_is: Lessons from Anti-waste Social Experiment that Seemed to Generate More Waste

sections.label: NEA Waste Cafe campaign
sections.summary: NEA used collected disposable cups in a roving exhibition to raise awareness about reducing, reusing and recycling, and welcomes feedback.

sentences.speaker: The Senior Minister of State for Sustainability and the Environment (Dr Amy Khor Lean Suan) (for the Minister for Sustainability and the Environment)
sentences.text: With "The Waste Cafe", the National Environment Agency (NEA) had sought to illustrate the cumulative environmental impact of a seemingly simple act of consuming coffee using a disposable cup.

sentences.speaker: The Senior Minister of State for Sustainability and the Environment (Dr Amy Khor Lean Suan) (for the Minister for Sustainability and the Environment)
sentences.text: The collected used cups were repurposed into impactful educational exhibits that are roving across Singapore to raise public awareness about the importance of reducing, reusing and recycling.

sentences.speaker: The Senior Minister of State for Sustainability and the Environment (Dr Amy Khor Lean Suan) (for the Minister for Sustainability and the Environment)
sentences.text: We have noted the views of those who felt that the experiment could have been done differently and have suggested areas for improvement.

sentences.speaker: The Senior Minister of State for Sustainability and the Environment (Dr Amy Khor Lean Suan) (for the Minister for Sustainability and the Environment)
sentences.text: We welcome feedback from all parties and will take them into consideration to improve our future campaigns.

sentences.speaker: Dr Amy Khor Lean Suan
sentences.text: As I noted, the collected used cups were actually repurposed and used as part of the roving exhibition.

sentences.speaker: Dr Amy Khor Lean Suan
sentences.text: In fact, some of it is used as a facade of now what we call The Waste Less Cafe, where the members of the public can get free coffee if they bring their reusable mug.
